# Curated Feeds
> Privacy-first RSS reader for Android. Beautiful cards, swipe-to-save, offline-ready, zero ads, zero tracking. Built by Rajat Kashyap in Flutter. Free worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/): product overview, features, FAQ, direct download
- [Blog](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/blog/): RSS tips, productivity, content curation
- [About](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/about/): founder story, mission, technical stack, timeline
- [Screenshots](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/screenshots/): UI previews (home feed, swipe gestures, dark theme)
- [Privacy Policy](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/privacy/): zero-data-collection policy

- [10 Productivity Tips for RSS Power Users](https://curatedfeeds.web.app/blog/productivity-tips-rss-readers/)
